subject: general
question: Which of the following soil requires minimum tillage because of its self-cultivating feature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Black soil.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Black soil** is also known as **regur soil or black cotton soil.**
 
• It is found in the **Deccan plateau** and is particularly well-suited for** growing cotton crops.**
 
• It has a **high clay content**, which makes it highly **retentive of moisture** and **nutrients.**
 
• This means that it requires **less frequent irrigation and fertilization, **which in turn reduces the need for **tilling and weeding.**
 
• The **high clay content** also makes **black soil heavy** and** difficult to plow**, which is why it is often referred to as** "sticky" soil.**
 
• However, this also means that it is** highly stable **and** resistant to erosion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Peaty soil** (option 3) is a type of soil that is characterized by a **high organic content.** 

 
 
• It is found in **wetlands and marshes** and is** not suitable **for agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Laterite soil** (option 2) is a type of soil that is formed in** tropical and subtropical regions.** 
 
 
• It is highly weathered and has a **high iron and aluminum content**. 
 
• It is** not suitable **for agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Red soil** (option 1) is a type of soil that is** commonly **found in India. 
 
 
• It is formed from the **weathering of igneous rocks** and has a **reddish color** due to the presence of** iron oxide.** 
 
• It is suitable for growing crops like **pulses, millets, and oilseeds.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "The **correct answer** is option 4" is correct.
